model_output.claim_cardinality: one claim per allowed required point; duplicate point IDs rejected
model_output.required_point_rule: claim point must be in supported or partially-supported mappings
model_output.support_id_rule: every support ID must belong to the same required-point mapping
model_output.coverage_rule: all allowed required points must be represented
model_output.claim_text_rule: non-empty, bounded, injection-safe; runtime deterministically emits mapped support text
model_output.limitation_fields: not emitted by model; Runtime appends deterministic partial limitation
model_output.citation_fields: not emitted by model; Citation support units remain upstream input
model_output.refusal_representation: model does not emit refusal; Runtime fail-closed refusal carries reason codes

runtime_output.safety_authority: original Answer V1 parser/validator and Runtime support package validation
